texte.C’est le point d’entrée du dispositif AI: It is the entry point to the AI Act framework: it shows the progress of your four workstreams (map, classify, assess, document) and opens each module concerned directly. Use it as a steering dashboard, not as a data-entry tool.
texte.C’est le seul livrable de la greffe qui: It is the only deliverable of the graft that cannot be derived from ANY # document: a model is not an information asset; it has a life cycle, training data and affected persons.
texte.C’est le seul point qui ne se rattrape p: It is the only point that cannot be caught up later. Code whose reasons nobody knows cannot be maintained: at the first change, it is rewritten, and the announced gain is paid back with interest.
texte.C’est le vecteur d’attaque le plus direc: It is the most direct attack vector opened up by development assistance, and it requires no access to your information system from the attacker.
texte.C’est là que le plan envoie le plus souv: That is where the plan sends you most often, and it is no accident: the Annex A # controls ALSO serve the ten measures of Article #(#) of NIS #. A single implementation, two standards that rise.

texte.Datez les critères d’acceptation AVANT d: Date the acceptance criteria BEFORE rating: clause # a) requires them to be established, and writing them after seeing the results gives a register where everything is acceptable. The screen compares the two dates, because it is the only way to show this order. Then, for each risk: the property affected — confidentiality, integrity, availability —, an owner, a rating. And at the end, acceptance of the residual risk, WRITTEN, DATED, by the owner themselves.
